columns.event_id: string: sha256(source, repo, issue, subject_id, event_type, ts as normalized UTC); archive events: sha256(source, repo, '', record_hash, event_type, '')
columns.ts: string: ISO 8601, normalized to UTC 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ' by emit()
columns.org: string: owner segment of the normalized repo, or 'unresolved'
columns.subject_id: string: identity of the thing the event is about (required: it is load-bearing for event_id)
columns.attrs: object<string, scalar>: ids, kinds, verdicts, counts -- never bodies; no nesting, strings <= 200 chars, body-like key tokens refused
